Load Claude-chan onto any page把 Claude-chan 加载到任意网页

Full version = sprites (default). Every method below loads the real sprite art: 21 hand-drawn poses and 15 motions, fetched from the base URL (or embedded in the inline build). Simplified version = a code-drawn stand-in that appears only if the sprites cannot be loaded, or when you ask for it with simplified:true. It has fewer expressions/poses and no real art.

完整版 = 精灵图（默认）。下面每种方式都会加载真正的精灵图：21 个手绘姿势和 15 个动作，从基础地址获取（内嵌版则直接内置）。简化版 = 代码绘制的替身，只有在精灵图无法加载时才会出现，或当你用 simplified:true 主动要求时。它的表情和姿势更少，也没有真正的美术。

  • The simplified version lacks: the 21 hand-drawn poses (idea, giggle, cheer, typing, explain, away, ...), the real anime art (it is a plain code-drawn figure), and the sprite cross-fades. It only tilts, blinks, moves brows, mouth and arms.简化版缺少：21 个手绘姿势（灵感、咯咯笑、欢呼、打字、讲解、离开等）、真正的动漫美术（只是简单的代码绘制人物）以及精灵图的淡入淡出。它只会倾斜、眨眼、动眉毛、嘴和手臂。
  • How to tell: after loading, claudeChan.renderer is "sprites" (full) or "simplified", claudeChan.isSimplified is true/false, and claudeChan.help() prints it. If the sprites fail, the console shows claude-chan: sprites could not be loaded from …; showing the SIMPLIFIED code-drawn version.如何判断：加载后 claudeChan.renderer 为 "sprites"（完整）或 "simplified"（简化），claudeChan.isSimplified 为 true/false，claudeChan.help() 也会打印。精灵图加载失败时，控制台会显示 claude-chan: sprites could not be loaded from …; showing the SIMPLIFIED code-drawn version。

Pick one way below: a console line, a bookmark, or a userscript. Every snippet already uses the base URL from the field, so it is ready to copy.

下面任选一种方式：控制台一行代码、书签或用户脚本。每段代码都已经填好了上方输入框里的基础地址，可以直接复制。

  • https://kmaj1st.github.io/claude-chan/: GitHub Pages (default when this page is opened as a file).https://kmaj1st.github.io/claude-chan/：GitHub Pages（以本地文件打开本页时的默认值）。
  • http://127.0.0.1:5179/: local copy, after npm run serve:loader.http://127.0.0.1:5179/：本地副本，先运行 npm run serve:loader。
  • https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Kmaj1st/claude-chan@main/: jsDelivr, works only once the GitHub repository is public.https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Kmaj1st/claude-chan@main/：jsDelivr，仅在 GitHub 仓库公开后可用。

1. Console (script hot-load)1. 控制台（脚本热加载）

Open the page where you want her, press F12 (or Ctrl+Shift+J / Cmd+Option+J), open the Console tab, paste this line and press Enter:

打开要放她的网页，按 F12（或 Ctrl+Shift+J / Cmd+Option+J），切到 Console（控制台） 标签，粘贴下面这行并回车：

document.head.append(Object.assign(document.createElement('script'),{src:'https://kmaj1st.github.io/claude-chan/hotload/loader.js'}))

Or as a module import (also works where document.head is missing):

或者用模块导入（在没有 document.head 的页面也能用）：

import('https://kmaj1st.github.io/claude-chan/hotload/loader.js')
  • Chrome and Edge block the first paste into the console: type allow pasting, press Enter, then paste again. Firefox asks the same.Chrome 和 Edge 会拦截第一次粘贴：先输入 allow pasting 并回车，再粘贴一次。Firefox 也会这样提示。
  • What you should see: Claude-chan in the bottom-left corner within a second, and window.claudeChan in the console.应看到：一秒内 Claude-chan 出现在左下角，控制台里可以访问 window.claudeChan。
  • Running it twice does nothing: there is never more than one mascot.重复运行不会有副作用：页面上永远只有一个吉祥物。
  • Remove her with claudeChan.unload(). Reloading the page removes her too.用 claudeChan.unload() 移除她；刷新页面也会移除。

2. Bookmarklet2. 书签

Drag this button to your bookmarks bar (show it with Ctrl+Shift+B). Click the bookmark on any page to add Claude-chan; click it again to remove her.

把这个按钮拖到书签栏（Ctrl+Shift+B 显示书签栏）。在任意网页点击该书签即可加入 Claude-chan，再点一次移除。

Claude-chan

If dragging does not work: create a new bookmark and paste this code into its URL field.

如果拖不动：新建一个书签，把下面的代码粘贴到网址栏。

javascript:(()=>{const c=window.claudeChan;if(window.__claudeChanLoader&&c&&c.unload){c.unload();return}const s=document.createElement("script");s.src="https://kmaj1st.github.io/claude-chan/hotload/loader.js";s.onerror=()=>alert("claude-chan: could not load "+s.src+" (blocked by this site's Content-Security-Policy? See docs/HOT-LOAD.md)");(document.head||document.documentElement).appendChild(s)})()

3. Userscript (every page, automatically)3. 用户脚本（每个网页自动加载）

Install Tampermonkey or Violentmonkey, then open one of these links; the manager offers to install it:

先安装 Tampermonkey 或 Violentmonkey 扩展，再打开下面的链接，扩展会弹出安装页面：

  • Install claude-chan.user.js安装 claude-chan.user.js (plain loader, about 50 KB; FULL version, fetches the sprites from the base URL)（普通加载器，约 50 KB；完整版，从基础地址获取精灵图）
  • Install claude-chan.inline.user.js安装 claude-chan.inline.user.js (inline, strict-CSP sites; FULL version, all 21 poses and 15 motions embedded, about 2.3 MB)（内嵌版，适用于严格 CSP 的网站；完整版，内嵌全部 21 个姿势和 15 个动作，约 2.3 MB）
  • It runs on every page (@match *://*/*). To limit it, edit the @match lines in the manager, for example https://example.com/*.默认在所有网页运行（@match *://*/*）。要限制范围，在扩展里编辑 @match 行，例如 https://example.com/*。
  • The userscripts load sprites from https://kmaj1st.github.io/claude-chan/.用户脚本从 https://kmaj1st.github.io/claude-chan/ 加载图像。

4. Sites with a strict Content-Security-Policy4. 内容安全策略（CSP）严格的网站

Some sites (for example GitHub) only allow their own scripts. Symptom: nothing appears, the console shows Refused to load the script … because it violates the following Content Security Policy directive, and the bookmarklet shows an alert.

有些网站（例如 GitHub）只允许自己的脚本。现象：什么都没出现，控制台显示 Refused to load the script … Content Security Policy，书签会弹出提示。

  • Use the inline userscript (claude-chan.inline.user.js): the manager injects it, and the sprites are embedded.改用内嵌版用户脚本（claude-chan.inline.user.js）：由扩展注入，图像已内嵌。
  • If even data: images are blocked, the sprites cannot load and she shows the SIMPLIFIED code-drawn version instead (fewer poses, no real art; see the top of this page).如果连 data: 图像也被禁止，精灵图无法加载，她会显示简化版（代码绘制，姿势更少，没有真正的美术；见本页顶部）。
  • The console line and the bookmarklet add a script tag, which CSP blocks. Pasting the contents of claude-chan.inline.js into the console works on most CSP sites.控制台代码和书签会添加 script 标签，会被 CSP 拦截。把 claude-chan.inline.js 的文件内容粘贴到控制台，在大多数 CSP 网站上可用。

5. Options and console commands5. 选项与控制台命令

Set options before loading, as window.claudeChanConfig or as data-* attributes on the script tag:

在加载前设置选项：用 window.claudeChanConfig，或在 script 标签上写 data-* 属性：

window.claudeChanConfig = { position: 'bottom-right', dock: 'free', size: 180, zIndex: 2147483000, simplified: false };
document.head.append(Object.assign(document.createElement('script'),{src:'https://kmaj1st.github.io/claude-chan/hotload/loader.js'}))
<script src="https://kmaj1st.github.io/claude-chan/hotload/loader.js" data-position="bottom-right" data-size="180"></script>
  • position: bottom-left (default), bottom-right, top-left, top-right. dock: free (drag anywhere) or fixed-default. size: height in px. zIndex: stacking order.position：bottom-left（默认）、bottom-right、top-left、top-right。dock：free（可随意拖动）或 fixed-default。size：高度（像素）。zIndex：层级。
  • simplified: false (default, full sprite version) or true to deliberately show the SIMPLIFIED code-drawn stand-in. sprites: URL of the sprite folder (default: base + assets/chars/).simplified：false（默认，完整精灵版）或 true（主动显示简化的代码绘制替身）。sprites：精灵图文件夹地址（默认 base + assets/chars/）。
  • Attributes: data-position, data-dock, data-size, data-z-index, data-base, data-sprites, data-frames, data-simplified.属性名：data-position、data-dock、data-size、data-z-index、data-base、data-sprites、data-frames、data-simplified。

Console commands once she is loaded:

加载后可在控制台使用：

claudeChan.help()                  // list of commands
claudeChan.hide()                  // hide for this page load
claudeChan.hide({ persist: true }) // stay hidden after reloads (until show())
claudeChan.show()                  // show again
claudeChan.toggle()                // hide/show, returns true when visible
claudeChan.setPosition(0.8, 0.9)   // fractions 0..1 of the window (numbers > 1 are px)
claudeChan.resetPosition()         // back to the home corner
claudeChan.unload()                // remove her completely
claudeChan.unload({ forget: true }) // also forget the stored position
claudeChan.renderer                // "sprites" (full version) or "simplified"

6. Troubleshooting6. 故障排查

  • Nothing appears. Look at the status line at the top of this page: it must say OK for your base URL. In DevTools open the Network tab and check that loader.js returns 200.什么都没出现。先看本页顶部的状态行，必须显示 OK。在开发者工具的 Network（网络） 标签里确认 loader.js 返回 200。
  • Wrong base URL (404): the base must be the folder that contains hotload/, ending with /.基础地址错误（404）：基础地址必须是包含 hotload/ 的目录，并以 / 结尾。
  • CSP error in the console: see section 4.控制台出现 CSP 错误：见第 4 节。
  • Ad or script blockers can block loader.js; allow the base host for that site.广告或脚本拦截扩展可能拦截 loader.js；为该网站放行基础地址的域名。
  • Inside an iframe she does not mount unless frames: true is set; run the line in the top page.在 iframe 里默认不加载，除非设置 frames: true；请在顶层页面运行。
  • Mixed content: an https:// page may not load scripts from http:// hosts, except http://127.0.0.1 (localhost counts as secure).混合内容：https:// 页面不能从 http:// 地址加载脚本，http://127.0.0.1 除外（本机地址视为安全）。
  • Old art or old behaviour after an update: GitHub Pages lets browsers cache files for 10 minutes. Wait, or hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5 / Cmd+Shift+R). A base you set in window.claudeChanConfig.base always wins over the one baked into the userscript.更新后仍是旧图像或旧行为：GitHub Pages 允许浏览器缓存文件 10 分钟。请稍等，或强制刷新（Ctrl+F5 / Cmd+Shift+R）。在 window.claudeChanConfig.base 中自行设置的基础地址总是优先于用户脚本内置的地址。
  • 404 from jsDelivr: jsDelivr only serves public repositories. Use the GitHub Pages base until the repository is public.jsDelivr 返回 404：jsDelivr 只提供公开仓库的文件。仓库公开前请使用 GitHub Pages 地址。
